## Architecture Review Checklist

- [ ] **Trade-offs documented** -- Both costs and benefits stated for every recommendation
- [ ] **Context provided** -- States when the pattern applies AND when it does not
- [ ] **Forces identified** -- Architectural forces driving the decision are explained
- [ ] **Evolution considered** -- Migration paths and future adaptability addressed
- [ ] **Team assumptions stated** -- Team size, skill, and organization assumptions noted
- [ ] **Alternatives acknowledged** -- Related patterns and alternatives referenced

## Content Checklist

- [ ] Validated against real-world usage or established literature
- [ ] Follows project structure and naming conventions
- [ ] Includes usage examples with expected output
- [ ] Markdown renders correctly
- [ ] Links are valid
